newsitem.title: UK: Gold prices stage a sudden, sharp rally.
newsitem.headline: Gold prices stage a sudden, sharp rally.

text.p: The price of gold staged a sudden, sharp rally rising by about five dollars an ounce within an hour on Thursday. Gold was indicated as high as $351.35 an ounce, its best in three weeks, after a London afternoon fixing at $345.00. Dealers said the lead came from the New York Comex gold futures market and that some speculative fund money moved back to gold. The short covering rally extended a rebound from 3-3/4 year lows down at almost $336 on February 12 when the market sank under fears of central bank bullion sales. Traders said sentiment on Thursday was helped by news that the South African Reserve Bank governor, Chris Stals, said he did not think that Belgian and Dutch central bank gold sales last year would be followed by other selling by central banks.

The accelerated recovery after its slide of recent weeks did not surprise some analysts. "It's not surprising. Gold was well undervalued against silver. The $352-353 level would also be a 50 percent retracement from the year's decline from $370..." said a senior London-based bullion dealer.
Silver, platinum and palladium also posted strong late gains. --London Newsroom +0171 44 542 7729
